reviewed_by: Codex focused Quiet Lens UI review
reason: The branch adds the opt-in Quiet Lens theme to the real Nebula shell, composer, Session rail, and focus toolbar. The focused interface journey selects the theme, checks separate navigation contours, visible multiline and long drafts, the 60-second Session rail reveal, and the focus toolbar hidden, keyboard, and hover states. Its desktop and compact profiles cover fine-pointer focus controls; mobile Chromium and WebKit at 320, 390, and 430 px cover touch presentation. App and ThemeContext component tests cover Appearance discovery and saved preference restoration. A disposable production Core on a LAN origin supplements the selected browser regression.
exclusions: No backend, API, or native implementation changes, so Python and native tests are unrelated. No full frontend or Playwright suite, unrelated catalog journeys, provider turn validation, or physical-device run is selected. The Session rail only exists at wide desktop width, and the focus toolbar hiding rule only applies to fine-pointer devices; touch controls remain visible. Real-Core visual checks are reported separately from the focused mocked browser regression.
